title: Closed subspaces of an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A closed subspace of $X$ is a subobject $C$ of $X$ whose inclusion is representable by closed immersions of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Equivalently it is a subfunctor of $X$ that is an algebraic space with that property. Subobjects identify presentations by an isomorphism over $X$; their order is inclusion of subfunctors, with their full scheme structures.
